messages:
olivia_support: Heads-up — customer acme-inc reporting cross-region routing: they set Region header to a JSON array and traffic is landing in EU, causing ~300ms extra RTT and some intermittent 401s. Sample curl they sent below.

olivia_support: ```curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' -H 'Region: ["us-west"]' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate``` 

emma_eng: Reproduced locally with same header. Router treats the whole string '["us-west"]' as an unknown region token and falls back to EU. We're not stripping brackets/quotes when matching.

emma_eng: Router log snippet (sanitized): ```router: incoming headers: {region: ["us-west"]} -> route_lookup: no exact match -> fallback_region=eu-west -> request_id=req-0a1b2c``` 

juan_seo: Huh — client-side frameworks sometimes serialize multi-value headers as JSON arrays. We expected comma-separated values or plain token. This is a parsing mismatch, not a network issue.

olivia_support: Client is on a legacy HTTP client in their stack that does header serialization automatically. They can change to Region: us-west quickly, but they want a server-side workaround.

infra-bot: Quick mitigation: adding a router pre-processor to strip surrounding [ ] and quotes and split on , ; | would map '["us-west"]' -> 'us-west'. Can add as config flag behind a feature toggle.

mike_platform: +1 to a small pre-processor. Can we also log original header for a few hours to measure how many customers send JSON arrays? Add a 48h rollout and feature flag.

emma_eng: I'll open a tiny patch: normalize_region_header() that unquotes and trims punctuation, then do exact match. Will add robust unit tests for edge cases (JSON arr, bracketed, semicolon, pipe). Target PR today.

olivia_support: I'll notify Acme support contact to try plain 'Region: us-west' as immediate workaround. Requesting priority for the PR since this affects auth/routing for a paying account. /cc @mike_platform

juan_seo: Also FYI — docs snippet and SDK should be updated to explicitly mention allowed header formats to avoid recurrence.

olivia_support: Thanks — will update case and mark as escalated.
